written_by: Editor's list. Not taken from any source. To be corrected by trip reports.

items.reason: Water crossings run deepest in the afternoon, when snow melt peaks
High halts fall below freezing at night, even in summer

items.item: Rain suit that fits over riding gear
items.reason: Weather turns within the hour near the passes
The nearest repair can be a hundred kilometres away
Cheap, light, and a broken one ends the day

items.item: Spare tube, if your tyres use tubes
items.reason: A torn tube cannot be patched
Water crossings and dust strip it in a day
Only if the fuel check says so for your bike
Riders report that prepaid SIMs from other states do not work in Ladakh or Jammu and Kashmir
Card machines and phone payments need a network

items.item: Licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificate
items.reason: Asked for at check posts. Carry paper copies.

items.item: Identity proof, and permits or fee receipts where they apply

items.reason: The sun burns faster at height, and snow doubles it

items.item: Water, two litres on the bike
items.reason: Drinking enough is the simplest help against altitude sickness

items.item: Basic medicines, and any your doctor advises for altitude
items.reason: Ask a doctor before the trip, not a chemist on the way

items.item: This route saved to your phone
items.reason: Most of the road has no network
